# Apple NullAudio attribution

`Driver/MacStereoFixDriver.c` is modeled on Apple's NullAudio sample. The current
Apple distribution of that same C sample includes the notice preserved in
`Apple-NullAudio-LICENSE.txt`.

Source: [Creating an Audio Server Driver Plug-in](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coreaudio/creating-an-audio-server-driver-plug-in)

Archive retrieved September 9, 2026:
[Apple sample download](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/430ad6501f6f/CreatingAnAudioServerDriverPlugIn.zip)

This notice covers Apple's sample code. It does not change the licensing of
the independently written portions of MacStereoFix.
